main: Break free from the idea that meatless curry is bland! This chickpea tomato curry is surprisingly easy and packed with flavor, delivering an Indian-inspired taste right at home. The fluffy chickpeas provide a satisfying texture and protein, making a single bowl a hearty meal.
reply1:
Ingredients (2-3 servings):
• 1 can (400g) canned chickpeas (drained)
• 1 can whole peeled tomatoes (tomato hol)
• 1 onion
• 1 tbsp minced garlic
• 3 tbsp curry powder
• 200ml water
reply2: Sauté sliced onion 5 mins over medium heat until brown. Add garlic 30 secs, then curry powder 10 secs. Crush and add tomatoes, then water, cook 5 mins.
